# pymmcore-plus

> Control microscopes with Python: Micro-Manager's core, acquisition engine, widgets, and apps.

Python tools for controlling microscopes with Micro-Manager: pymmcore-plus (core + acquisition engine), useq-schema (experiment schema), pymmcore-widgets (Qt widgets), pymmcore-gui and napari-micromanager (applications).
